ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central and medial lobe regions, bounded by approximately 15% low-intensity black pixels along the perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white field covering the majority of both lobes. Low-intensity black banding follows the entire trailing edge and distal tips. Discrete, small low-intensity elliptical blobs are visible on the medial and distal regions of the right-side lobe (pixel-left).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel interior angle of approximately 50 degrees; depth of notch is roughly 15% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate-frequency serration along the continuous trailing boundary; approximately 15-18 distinct peaks and valleys with a pixel amplitude of 5-10 units, most pronounced on the right-lobe (pixel-left) trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave sweep originating from the median notch and extending toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete circular and elliptical high-contrast pixel clusters (dark outlines on white background) scattered across the medial and distal portions of the right lobe (pixel-left), consistent with barnacle attachment sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized circular parasitic/barnacle scars present on the ventral surface of the right lobe; significant jagged edge topography on the distal edge of the left lobe (pixel-right).
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced elongated and sharp distal tip on the left lobe (pixel-right) compared to the more rounded right lobe tip.
